Needs changes before merge.

The screenshots are present. The before, Quality and menu images load from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The new menu, preset, cache and work-plane tests pass. No fixture, golden, snapshot PNG, dependency or process file changed.

I reviewed the full diff, including the changes from parent #2835. I used the laws in upstream main at `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b`.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/look_at.rs:38`: Calculate the face normal with `setup_align::view_pose`, as picking and drawing do. `pick::first_hit_f` picks in the active setup's frame. This code transforms the picked triangle with `model::transform_of`, which omits the setup alignment. For a part turned 90 degrees about X, a local +Z face is shown along Y. This function still returns a Z normal. Thus, "Look at a face" does not face the clicked face. Add a test with a rotated setup and assert the normal in the shown frame. The current test uses an unaligned box. This code comes from parent #2835 and is still in this PR's diff.
2. `crates/app/src/view.rs:54`: Run the reached heavy lane on the final head and add its results to the PR body. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects all app heavy targets because `app::view` changed. The body says the heavy lanes did not run. Upstream `AGENTS.md:601` requires the reached tests to pass before the PR becomes ready. This review did not run them.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream main was clean. The worktree was `.claude/worktrees/review-2932`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner ran. The selected app and UI `--no-run` builds passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 21 steps, 18 passed, 3 failed. I set `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`. The UI library and GPU suites failed because no graphics adapter was available. The shell suite also failed its headless exit-code test. That entry uses the same headless renderer. These failures do not establish a product defect. They leave GPU rendering unverified here.

The six report-window failures give this error:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

`headless_run_succeeds` and the 13 GPU tests report `metal found no adapters`. This includes both new shadow and occlusion tests. `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero` reports `left: 1`, `right: 0`.

`cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run: none required. No test fixture or importer changed. The quick gate ran the changed `view_file` and `gpu_render` suites in full.

Heavy lanes: not run. The dry run selected the app lane; see request 2. Pixel snapshots and the wasm build did not run.

Mutations: not required for this diff. The new meshes and occlusion values are display data. They do not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or document geometry. No golden moved.

The inherited `sccache` wrapper made no build progress. I stopped that first planner attempt and ran the checks with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The face normal now uses `setup_align::view_pose`. `egui_app::tests::display_menu::look_at_uses_the_face_normal_in_the_active_setup_frame` pins the shown normal and camera direction after a 90-degree setup rotation. Reverting the fix made this test RED with normal `[0, 0, 1]`. Restoring the fix made it GREEN.
2. The reached app heavy lane ran on the final head. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 184 steps. The PR body now records these results.

Head: `615584eedad2e550aa6fa8b4092085322fbdf1f0`.

Clippy passed for app and UI with all targets and warnings denied. The quick gate passed 19 of 21 steps. UI library and shell tests failed because no graphics adapter was available. The new pin passed. GPU tests returned early without an adapter, so GPU rendering remains unverified.

Please re-review this head.
